name: IPT G - Watcher Guru Relay - LIVE PRIVATE

nodes.name: Manual - real source probe
nodes.notes: Purpose: Operator-only entry for tests or inspection. It does not run on a timer or receive unsolicited messages.

nodes.name: Fetch Watcher Guru public feed
nodes.notes: Purpose: Fetch the public Telegram channel preview. Return the page to the parser, which extracts visible posts and stable post identifiers.

nodes.name: Parse real Telegram posts
nodes.notes: Purpose: Extract stable post identifiers, visible text, dates and source URLs from the public channel page. Compute content fingerprints without asking an AI to rewrite the text.

nodes.name: Read Watcher Guru relay receipts
nodes.notes: Purpose: Read Google Sheets data using the saved credential. Pass the response and HTTP status to the next verifier; a successful transport response alone does not establish a valid business result.

nodes.name: Select unseen real posts
nodes.notes: Purpose: Compare visible real posts with durable completed relay receipts and choose unseen eligible posts. Finite source-window and edit limitations still apply.

nodes.name: New post decision
nodes.notes: Purpose: Route the item to an output branch according to the configured condition. No database mutation occurs in this routing node.

nodes.name: Return no new posts
nodes.notes: Purpose: Return the classified result for this branch. The output identifies a completed, suppressed, no-op or review outcome; it must not be confused with an unconditional successful trade.

nodes.name: Build exact Discord message
nodes.notes: Purpose: Preserve the parsed source text. H uses a full-text attachment when the post exceeds Discord message limits; G has its existing size guard.

nodes.name: Prepare durable relay job
nodes.notes: Purpose: Map the original relay message key, channel, text and optional full-text attachment to I’s stable delivery request.

nodes.name: Deliver through durable queue
nodes.notes: Purpose: Invoke workflow I with the current item. Wait for the child outcome before continuing.

nodes.name: Use confirmed durable receipt
nodes.notes: Purpose: Only COMPLETE queue results with a verified Discord message ID reach the existing relay receipt writer. Preserve n8n item pairing for each source post.

nodes.name: Prepare durable relay receipt
nodes.notes: Purpose: Verify Discord’s confirmed content/channel and attachment metadata against the original post before preparing the source-specific receipt.

nodes.name: Append Watcher Guru receipt
nodes.notes: Purpose: Send the prepared POST request to Google Sheets. The upstream Code node constructs the body and the downstream verifier checks the result. This is an external side-effect boundary when reachable.

nodes.name: Verify Watcher Guru relay
nodes.notes: Purpose: Check the preceding response or context against the expected identity, schema or outcome. A failed check stops this path instead of treating it as success.

parameters.content:
## Watcher Guru live relay
Public Telegram preview → stable post ID parsing → Google Sheets dedup → exact text to private #guru-news → durable receipt.

First run sends only the newest post, so historical backlog is suppressed. No Gemini, no fictional fixture, and no portfolio writes.

nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Purpose: Start the connected polling/recovery branch at its saved interval. This is approximately scheduled polling, not a push guarantee.

nodeGroups.name: Fetch and deduplicate
nodeGroups.description: Real public Watcher Guru source, stable ID parsing, and durable receipt lookup.
